scope: fixed-data supervised diagnostic, not strength or online training; one batch seed per subject

gradients.definition: raw policy CE gradients; KL has identical gradient. update=theta_after-theta_before. cos(update,-gradient)>0 or dot(gradient,update)<0 predicts descent locally; actual AdamW includes inherited moments, clipping and weight decay.
